page.label: Services
page.subtitle: Seven disciplines, one team. From product strategy through AI architecture to production deployment, without a handoff in the middle.
page.processSubtitle: Every engagement follows the same clear phases — from discovery and build through launch, marketing, and cloud scale.
page.ctaTitle: Talk to us about your project
page.ctaSubtitle: Free consultation, no commitment. Tell us what you're building and we'll map the path forward.

01.title: Product Strategy
01.summary: Vision, roadmap, and architecture so your product solves the right problems from day one.
01.desc: We align product vision with business goals before a single line of code is written. Roadmaps, scope, and architecture decisions that set your product up to win.

02.title: UX/UI Design
02.summary: Research-driven interfaces that feel intuitive, look stunning, and convert across every device.
02.desc: Interfaces that feel obvious to use and impossible to ignore. Research-backed design systems built for conversion, accessibility, and every screen size.

03.title: Frontend Engineering
03.summary: Pixel-perfect implementation in React, Next.js, and modern frameworks. Production-ready.
03.desc: Pixel-perfect implementation in modern frameworks. Fast, responsive, and maintainable frontends your team can extend long after launch.

04.title: Backend Engineering
04.summary: Production APIs, normalized schemas, and infrastructure that holds up under real load.
04.desc: APIs, databases, and services engineered for real-world load. Secure, observable infrastructure that scales with your user base.

05.title: AI & Automation
05.summary: LLM integration, retrieval, and workflow automation designed into the product, not bolted on.
05.desc: Intelligent features woven into your product — not bolted on after the fact. From LLM integrations to automated workflows that save hours every week.

06.title: Digital Marketing
06.summary: Data-driven campaigns, SEO, and growth strategies that turn traffic into measurable revenue.
06.desc: Growth isn't guesswork. We build marketing systems — paid, organic, and analytics — that align with your product and scale as you do.

07.title: Cloud Infrastructure
07.summary: Scalable cloud setup, CI/CD pipelines, and resilient infrastructure built for production.
07.desc: From migration to day-two operations, we design cloud environments that stay fast, secure, and cost-efficient under real traffic.

01.title: Discovery

05.desc: SEO, paid campaigns, and analytics wired to your launch — so growth is measurable from day one.

06.title: Cloud
06.desc: Migration, CI/CD, and production ops — infrastructure that scales with traffic and stays cost-efficient.
